caption: A camera flash fires in a dim hall, and the whole room is lit for an instant.

sa.check: The lighting lasts only an instant.
The flash comes first and the lighting comes with it.

pc.expect: The flash is a single brief burst and the room returns to dim immediately.
pc.fail: The room stays lit; or brightens gradually; or flashes repeatedly with one press.

pc.expect: Everything facing the camera is lit and shadows point away from it.
pc.fail: Only part of the room lights; or shadows point toward the camera; or the far side is lit and the near dark.
Another light comes on; or the room dims before the flash; or the lit area moves.

pc.expect: Colours stay the same, only brighter for the instant.
pc.fail: Objects change colour; or the flash is coloured; or the walls change.

pc.expect: The room's objects keep their number.
pc.fail: An object vanishes; or appears; or the camera duplicates.
Furniture rearranges; or the walls change; or the camera changes.
